summary: DRDGOLD filed a Form 6-K announcing the availability of an investor presentation regarding its Vision 2028 capital projects update. The presentation covers a new capital project at the Far West Gold Recoveries Driefontein 2 plant, commissioning timelines, and revised capital forecasts. There are no disclosed terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural details. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, or corporate actions.
